definitions.explanation: A traditional toy that spins on its pointed end, played with especially during the New Year season in Japan.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{独楽|こま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}している→回す：01158_mawasu⟧。
⟦お{正月|しょうがつ}→お正月：05586_oshougatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{独楽|こま}{回|まわ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んだ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: We played with spinning tops during New Year's.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{木製|もくせい}→木製：13083_mokusei_b⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{独楽|こま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{定番|ていばん}→定番：12265_teiban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{玩具|おもちゃ}だった。
examples.english: Long ago, wooden spinning tops were a standard toy for children.

notes:
WRITING:
The word can be written as:
- {独楽|こま} (ateji kanji)
- こま (hiragana)

The kanji {独楽|こま} is ateji (phonetic kanji with no semantic connection to the meaning). The characters literally mean 'alone' + 'fun.'

CULTURAL NOTE:
{独楽|こま}{回|まわ}し (top spinning) is a traditional New Year's game (⟦{正月|しょうがつ}{遊|あそ}び→正月遊び：18150_shougatsuasobi⟧) in Japan, along with ⟦{凧揚|たこあ}げ→凧揚げ：07128_takoage⟧ (kite flying), ⟦{羽根|はね}つき→羽根つき：07129_hanetsuki⟧ (shuttlecock), and ⟦かるた→かるた：21979_karuta⟧ (card games).

TYPES:
- ⟦{投|な}げ→投げ：21942_nage⟧{独楽|ごま} (throwing tops)
- ⟦{手回|てまわ}し→手回し：08127_temawashi⟧{独楽|ごま} (hand-spinning tops)
- ベイブレード (modern spinning top toys)
